events.text: Leak detector LD-DH2-01 alarm triggered. Underfloor cable-type sensor, Data Hall 2. Alarm class: brick:Leak_Alarm. Connected to iBMS / DCIM.

CRAH-DH2-01 condensate drain pan high-level alarm. Chilled-water supply temp stable at 7.0°C but return temp dropping (overcooling risk if CRAH-DH2-02 absorbs full load after isolation). N+1 redundancy confirmed: CRAH-DH2-02 operational and absorbing 60% load.

CMMS work order WO-2026-1012-0512 raised. Priority: P1. Asset: CRAH-DH2-01 + CHW-DC-LOOP-A DH-2 branch. Assigned to: Critical Facilities on-duty technician. Description: 'CRAH-DH2-01 condensate/CHW leak in Data Hall 2. N+1 maintained. Investigate and isolate affected branch.'

Critical facilities technician on-site DH-2. Visual: water from CRAH-DH2-01 condensate drain pan overflow, tracking along underfloor cable tray. Water confined to underfloor plenum — not in contact with IT racks or power whips. Cold aisle containment intake temp stable at 24°C. CRAH-DH2-02 absorbing load.

Isolation sub-valve ISV-DC-DH2 closed (CHW branch isolation for CRAH-DH2-01 on DH-2 loop). CRAH-DH2-01 taken offline. CRAH-DH2-02 absorbing 95% of DH-2 cooling load. Cold aisle temp: 24.3°C (within tolerance). No IT power-down required.

MOSAIC engine evaluation (asset_overlay: data_centre): Rule TS-07 (v1.3) triggered — water in data hall, near electrical infrastructure. Action 'Re-energise affected CRAH / DB' blocked. Missing evidence: lew_signoff, insulation_resistance_ok. Escalate to: dc_critical_facilities_manager (Steven Wong) — DC asset override applies. Critical facilities manager co-signs. Provenance: ce-interview-2026-10-02#00:14:32.

Client SLA notification gate (DC-SLA-01) triggered: hyperscale client SLA requires notification within 15 min of detection. Detection at 09:15, notification deadline 09:30. Client notified via SLA portal at 09:28 — within SLA window. No SLA credit triggered.

Critical Facilities Manager Steven Wong on-site for co-sign inspection. LEW Rahul Menon dispatched for DB inspection (switchgear room B1-ER-01, no water in switchgear but perimeter moisture check required). Insulation resistance test pending CRAH-DH2-01 area dry-out. CRAH-DH2-02 maintaining cooling. Incident status: monitoring, no outage.
